results.comment: [USER]  There is a game show called "Price Is Right" that is popular in America. In that game show, there are women/models who help introduce items contestants can win if they can guess how much each item costs.  So what the angry brother is saying, is that the model on Price Is Right isn't doing a good job presenting those items because contestants think they are worth less than they really are. So the joke is that the brother is marrying a beautiful and successful model, and the other brother has to be negative about everything, so the only thing he can criticize is that he thinks she isn't a good presenter of the items she displays. (This joke is expressed best in an idiom in English called "Sour Grapes" based off of "Aesop's Fables".
